6167.title: Proactive OAuth rejection disables unexpired pool credentials
6167.rootCauseOneLine: Permanent proactive OAuth failures bypass unexpired-token fallback; request handling records an account error while normal background handling suppresses it without remembering the rejected refresh credential.
6167.proposedFix: Review a rejected-refresh-credential state model that preserves valid access-token use, prevents unchanged-token replay, reconciles replacement secrets, and publishes error transitions.
6167.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts using synthetic endpoints and real SQLite; no live grant race or provider token-revocation behavior was tested. No automatic PR because the repair changes authentication behavior. Test, configuration, and outputs are inline under the reports repository policy.
